<function name="unpack" parent="Global" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>This function takes a numeric indexed table and return all the members as a vararg. If specified, it will start at the given index and end at end index.</description>
	<realm>Shared and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="tbl" type="table">The table to generate the vararg from.</arg>
		<arg name="startIndex" type="number" default="1">Which index to start from. Optional.</arg>
		<arg name="endIndex" type="number" default="#tbl">Which index to end at. Optional, even if you set StartIndex.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="vararg">Output values</ret>
	</rets>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Prints a vararg</description>
	<code>print( unpack({"a", "b", "c"}) )</code>
	<output>
```
 a b c
```</output>

</example>
